R10 (drive-convert, over-strictness): a city OpenDocument file (the same container, not a Drive export), an archive replay of one (two archive.org hops) and a city PDF gain no conversion; each chain is exactly the layer step, byte-identical to the pre-conversion pins

R10 R11 (producer-provenance): through the real pdf entry, a text layer whose /Info names OCR software reads exactly [layer, ocr(<product>)]: the product as the file spelled it, the field and marker row that said so, no version, cap null with measured_by naming /Info; the basis names the product as a derivation sequence; the reading still determined at tier 1
R10 (producer-provenance): a layer with no OCR marker (no /Info, authoring software, an unanticipated spelling, malformed metadata) stays exactly [layer], and "authored" appears nowhere in its chain

R11 R21 (reading-wire): text tier 1 could not determine is a failed reading naming tier 1's own marker: an encrypted PDF (encrypted), and with no pdf-worker bound a font with no Unicode map (no_tounicode); no entity invented, no reader claimed to have run

tests: R37 (G124): WHOLE_READ_MAX and MULTIPART_READ_MAX are READ_BOUNDS' rows (pdf bytes, office text bytes), and the module's source writes no numeric literal for a byte ceiling
R37 R54 (G124a, PDF A3): a PDF of the bound plus one is stated at once, final, with its size and the limit, nothing loaded; the bound itself is read (A2's ceiling)
R37 (G133c): an entry that throws on the file's own bytes is final with its reason, never transient
R53 (G129b, DOCS F1 shape): a store failure at tick 2 comes back transient with the cursor kept and more still true; the retry reads on to the end, every line once

R47 R15 (G128d, red.mjs N15's shape): a page over CAPTURE_TEXT_UNIT_CAP is carried as consecutive chunks of its page, run 0, 1, ..., none truncated, their text the page's, read whole and in pieces alike; its last word is in the last chunk
R47 (G128d, DOCS T14): chunkUnits breaks at a space, never inside a word, and a phrase across a seam is whole in one chunk or the other (an overlap)

R47 (G134d, DOCS O4 at the interface): every part an entry emits is a unit with its kind; the body's units are body; a footnote's figure is found in a footnote unit; allUnitsOf accepts every kind of the closed list
R47 (G166): a paragraph a text_box part names in paras is no body unit, so the box's words are one unit of kind text_box; without paras every paragraph stays a body unit

R47 (G166, pptx): a slide's body unit is its bodyText when it states one, so a text box's words are one unit of kind text_box; a box-only slide has no body unit; without bodyText the slide's text stays
R47 R41 (G128g, G128h): a sheet's units carry lineRows, every block naming its rows, the repeated header line naming row 1, so a join that drops a repeated first line gives each row once
R48: completenessOf is whole exactly when nothing more follows and nothing is skipped, owed or failed; stated for a refusal; none when nothing was offered
R48 (G128a, SCAN C1 shape): a 30-page scan with 24 OCR'd is partial, owed 6; read to its end it is whole
R48 (G128b, SCAN C11 shape): a text page with one large unread picture counts the picture owed, so the reading is never whole; control: a fully read text page is whole
R45 (G130): rangeSource reads only the ranges asked; plan of a 40 MB file reads its head and its tail, detects the kind, and judges the size against the kind's bound
R45 control: a file under every bound plans ok and reads in one piece with more false; windowCursor round-trips its fields
R45 (G132): every answer carries counters {written, skipped, owed, failed} and next; written is the units carried
R49 (G131g, DOCS T7 at the interface): a windows-1252 text and a UTF-16LE text with BOM are decoded by ooxml's rule, the encoding stated, never U+FFFD with failure null; control: UTF-8 as before
R49: a text whose replacement passes 0.5 % of its characters is partial with the count
R54 (G125a): a page the OCR member refuses from its header (IMAGE_TOO_LARGE) is stated with that reason, final, never owed or retried
R54 (G129c): a page the caller states killed its reader three times is not asked again and is stated PAGE_KILLED_READER; the rest is read
R54 (G125a): a page whose OCR call answered 5xx is named killed on the reading, so the ledger can count the attempt against that page

R56 (G137d): legibility is stored beside a page's text; a page under four fifths is kept and marked partly legible; a page the member refused under one fifth stores no text and is stated; the same for a picture and a PDF page
R58: no reading step imports file-safety or reads a scan, grade or safe view

R29 (N853a): every refusal the real ai-accounts.accountFor answers for the act is aiRefusal exactly as accountFor answers it: NO_ACCOUNT, AI_USE_SWITCHED_OFF, GROUP_KEY_NOTICE_DUE, AI_KEPT_AWAY, PROJECT_AI_KEPT_AWAY, a project the member cannot see; and read passes none of it into the reading

R29 (N853a, control, K874): every other stop is aiNote alone, with no aiRefusal key: a declining AI, an unreachable AI, an answer naming no model, no text returned, no member's act, no accounts, an accountFor or useCheck that throws, no limits checked, no AI set up, no page left; and a filled reading carries none

R31: a transcription whose accounts (ai-accounts) answers NO_ACCOUNT answers that refusal as given in aiRefusal and fills nothing; control: one whose accounts.accountFor answers an account transcribes the asked pages as before, the same act asked
R31 (controls): an accounts that is absent, has no accountFor, or throws stops the AI tier with the aiNote for an account that could not be checked, no aiRefusal, nothing filled, the AI not asked
R31 (through T48): a transcription that hands credentials and no accounts is read the same way; when accounts is handed it alone is asked, credentials never

R18 R19 (R29): readingProvenance credits a page an ai_transcription step covers to tier 4, named by the model, never to tier 3's OCR member for the pixels before it; compareProvenance attributes a change to it

R29 (N835, ai-use R1): the paying owner is spelled from the bare member id: a member handed stamped `member:ann` and one handed bare `ann` are both judged as owner `member:ann`, never `member:member:ann`, and both are served by her own account
R30 R23: tier3SeedFrom seeds the stored reading's pixels -> ai_transcription part beside its pixels -> ocr part, each under its own chain and with its own words

R30 R6 R29: a re-read that asks the OCR member for the rest keeps the AI's page with its text and chain, asks neither the OCR member nor the AI for it again, and the reading it composes still carries it
R30: the AI's page is never dropped when the OCR member has every page already, fails, or is not bound; with none bound only the page nobody read is left for the AI
R30 (negative control): a stored reading with only OCR parts is seeded as before, and a re-read of it is tier 3 with no AI part
